payout_quote: Earning rewards is easy. Simply upload eligible receipts by using the Amazon Shopper Panel app to take pictures of paper receipts or by forwarding email receipts to receipts@panel.amazon.com and you'll earn up to $10 per month towards either an Amazon Balance or a charitable donation. (panel.amazon.com) ... Receipts: You will earn a reward for each eligible receipt uploaded through the receipts tab, with an opportunity to earn up to a $10 reward each month. (panel.amazon.com/FAQRewards.html)
timing: Monthly: upload receipts any time during the month; the up-to-$10 reward posts toward your Amazon Balance each month
eligibility: 18+; Amazon customer in US, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Spain or Japan; invitation-only - join the waitlist in the app if you weren't invited
steps: Download the Amazon Shopper Panel app (or join the waitlist if not invited)
Photograph paper receipts in the app OR forward email receipts to receipts@panel.amazon.com
Upload enough eligible receipts each month to hit the $10 cap
Complete any short surveys offered for extra rewards
Rewards land as Amazon Balance (or charitable donation) each month
catches: This pays in AMAZON BALANCE (store credit), not cash - you cannot withdraw it to a bank
Invitation-only with a waitlist - you may not get in right away; the official site says to join the waitlist in the app if you weren't invited
Only receipts from purchases OUTSIDE Amazon count; Amazon/Whole Foods receipts are excluded
Extra receipts beyond the $10 monthly cap earn nothing and don't roll over
You are trading your purchase data for the reward - Amazon says it deletes sensitive info like prescriptions, but your shopping history is the product here
biggest_catch: Up to $10 a month in Amazon store credit - not cash - and entry is invitation-only with a waitlist, so you may not get in right away. Your receipt data is what you're selling.

maximize: Amazon's own instructions allow forwarding email receipts to receipts@panel.amazon.com, so forward every online order confirmation the day it arrives - that is zero-effort earnings. For paper receipts, snap them in the app the same day you shop so none expire past the month-end cutoff. Check the Surveys tab in the app too: completed surveys add rewards on top of the receipt earnings, up to the $10 monthly cap.
